paragraphs.text: Gargos , known as the Vicious Watcher , is a legendary hydra from an unknown plane.

Gargos was introduced as a character in Core Set 2020 . It is a hydra whose scales are pale, striped green, resembling ancient, weathered stone, giving it natural armor. Gargos was featured in the Secret Lair Drop Series: Calling All Hydra Heads with new art painted in the psychedelic style of CatDirty .
